proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.operations
proposed_widenings.justification: The rope moves 10 ft autonomously at the start of each caster turn after being commanded, until reaching its destination. This requires an ongoing operation (on_caster_turn_start → reposition_attachment) attached to a magic-item activation. ActivatedAbilityMechanics only has phases (one-shot); it lacks an operations array. SpellMechanics.OngoingEffectMechanics has this pattern but it is spell-only.
proposed_widenings.evidence: 10 feet at the start of each of your subsequent turns until reaching its destination or until you tell it to stop

proposed_widenings.name: PassiveOperation.trigger.unit: 'minute'
proposed_widenings.justification: The rope regenerates 1 HP every 5 minutes. PassiveOperation.trigger.unit only allows 'hour' or 'day'. A 'minute' unit is needed to express sub-hour periodic effects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: It regains 1 Hit Point every 5 minutes as long as it has at least 1 Hit Point.

proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy: 'at_zero_hp'
proposed_widenings.justification: The rope is destroyed when it reaches 0 HP (not when a charge pool empties). Existing destruction policies are charge-pool-scoped (last_charge_roll, permanent_on_empty, none). This item has its own HP track and is destroyed deterministically at 0 HP with no charge pool involved.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the rope drops to 0 Hit Points, it is destroyed.

proposed_widenings.name: item_hp_profile (item-as-object stats surface)
proposed_widenings.justification: The rope has AC 20, HP 20, and damage immunities as an object with its own durability. CreatedObjectDurability covers objects created by spells/activations but there is no surface for the magic item itself having HP/AC/immunity stats as part of its record. This is needed to express the rope's own defensive profile.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The rope has AC 20, HP 20, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate: 'item_in_state' (knotted/unknotted mode gate)
proposed_widenings.justification: The climbing Advantage only applies while the rope is knotted. There is no EquipmentPredicate variant that gates grants on the item's current toggled mode/state. The existing predicates cover worn/held/wielding equipment states but not a discrete item-mode toggle.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While knotted, the rope shortens to a 50-foot length and grants Advantage on ability checks made to climb using the rope.

notes: Five surface gaps prevent honest encoding. The primary blocker is that ActivatedAbilityMechanics lacks an 'operations' array — the per-turn autonomous rope movement cannot be expressed as a one-shot phase. The atom vocabulary is adequate (reposition_attachment, modify_roll_advantage + skillFilter, grant_damage_immunity all exist), but the delivery structures are missing. All five gaps are new variants/fields on existing surface types; no new v4 taxonomy atoms are needed. Not structural_widening because the magic_item kind and composite passive+activation family pattern exist.
